purpose: Supported ID contracts for Eval 0 Check A. A listed field that breaks its contract is FAIL; fields not listed here keep the 'numbering gap or few examples is not an invalid-ID finding' rule. Enforced statically by Evals/tools/hg_injection_lint.py (check id_contract).
verified: 2026-10-18 against every base value in HarmonyGames_Gmail and HarmonyGames_Other_Services (hg4-2026-08-31 export, 2026-09-28 download)

contracts.rule: Gmail history_id is NULL or a decimal string (digits only), as the Gmail API defines it; labels such as 'hf_pf_reg_1' break Gmail search.
contracts.base_evidence: No base record carries a non-null history id: 21,192 of 88,726 thread files have "historyId": null and the rest omit it; no message record has the field; 8 of 28 users.json entries have historyId null and the rest omit it. NULL therefore matches the base; a value must be digits.
contracts.failure_evidence: Task 6aa8272b1b7a2df0fc0fea7b injected history_id 'hf_pf_reg_1'..'hf_pf_reg_3'; every Gmail search in its runs returned an error.

contracts.rule: Drive content_path is relative to the Drive export root: '<owner_email>/<path>', with no leading '/' and no 'root/' prefix. NULL means the file has no bytes (see Eval 0 on unreadable files).
contracts.base_evidence: All 30,436 non-null base content_path values (of 53,866 drive_files) start with the row's owner_email as the first segment; none starts with '/' or 'root/'. 30,421 resolve to bytes under gdrive/root/; the other 15 are filename-encoding losses in the local copy.
contracts.failure_evidence: Task 6abd857f96a9f77c7e518348 injected content_path 'root/marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co/UA Creative Recap - Jan 2026.pdf'; the agent's read returned 404.
